data: Beautiful game, Amazing soundtrack, Great gameplay
Amazing atmosphere, great music, amazing gameplay, and lots of secrets come together to make an almost perfect game
an absolutely amazing experience , fun game with tons of character highly recommend
very fun and challenging in the best way

Let me start by saying the most important part of this review, and I CANNOT stress this enough:

**STOP LOOKING INTO THIS GAME AND PLAY IT. THE LESS YOU KNOW GOING IN, THE BETTER. GO IN BLIND AND DISCOVER AND EXPLORE ON YOUR OWN, AND (IF AT ALL POSSIBLE) AVOID LOOKING UP SOLUTIONS. YOU WILL THANK YOURSELF LATER**

I came into this game expecting nothing more than a cool little puzzle platformer.....boy was I wrong.
I can honestly say I can't remember the last time I've been this impressed, surprised, and blown away by a game. No hand-holding, just exploration and discovery. The puzzles smart and challenging, the physics feel nice, and the sound/music is incredible. Honestly, this is the best game I've played in a very long time, and quite possibly one of the best I've ever played. I'm 30 hrs. in and I've only scratched the surface of the puzzles and mysteries hidden throughout the game. This game has layers and for those wanting to go deeper down the rabbit hole, it always goes deeper.
Top tier metroidvania. The non combat is very fun. Not many games can grab my attention this well.

Animal Well is the perfect mix of the simplicity of a classic retro game mixed with genius game design you'd find in a modern day game.

I would play this game for the atmosphere and the sound design alone. Barely any music besides certain moments that come out of no where from the near silence that make situations feel very intense.

For those looking to just play a fun game with satisfying puzzles and and interesting visuals I would more than recommend this game. From what I have seen and heard there is even more past beating the game that some have pushed past the 40 hour mark and still able to find new things. The secrets are extremely well hidden with some players taking notes on paper while playing just to keep track of everything.

10/10 game and definitely the best indie game this year so far
Played on the ps5 to completion because at the time the game ran horribly on my steam deck. Very fun game but unless that has already been fixed I would recommend not playing on the steam deck.

Came for videogamedunkey. Stayed for the creativity this small Metroidvania puzzle game offers. 40MB and 64 eggs later, I'm left feeling refreshed and excited to see what Bigmode works on next.

10/10 on Steam Deck.

It's a nice 2-d puzzle-platformer in the vein of Celeste or rain world! It's very rewarding and scratches my itch for satisfying puzzles. The difficulty curve is nice and gradual, which helps ease you into the game. Cute animals too!

I haven't felt this addicted to a game in a while. Even though I knew I had no chance of solving all the puzzles myself, even though after a certain point I was just reading a guide to do everything. I also recommend you to use the Steam page "A travelers guide to Animal Well" once you start feeling like the puzzles are too much for you. 

But the wonderful thing is, you can still beat the game like a regular metroidvania just by solving the more obvious puzzles. There are several good points to end your walkthrough if you don't feel like doing the entire thing.

Also, amazing community. All of those people coming together to crack all of those mysteries. That's partially why even reading the guides was fun.

Overall, if you don't mind either:
skipping the hardest parts for a nice and short playthrough 
or:
using outside help to see it all, 
I highly recommend this game to you.

cute but I have NO idea why there is HP in this game. I havent fought a boss yet dunno if there are any. So far HP means that if you get hit 4 times during a puzzle you restart 6 rooms ago, walk over and try again and loose all firecrackers... why?? also getting hit while in a jumping puzzle makes you fall down anyway, why give me 4 tries before getting punished with a "corpse run"?? just respawn me to the start of the puzzle room man.

one time, I had 1hp because I failed the puzzle 3 times and I did a buncha stuff since I last saved so I had to backtrack to save in case I failed the puzzle one more time, then came back, died again and walked back again to realise I had 3hp now (why doesnt saving fills you up to 3 hp if you respawn with 3hp anyway?) and my firecrackers were gone.

am I missing something?
Amazing game. It looks simple but there's loads to explore and a great time to be had. Absolutely recommending it.
100% recommend this game to anyone looking for a nice platform game to play. The level design is great as well as music and graphics.

Animal Well is the most fun I have had playing a game in a long time. The art style and music make it very pleasing to play, even if you feel like you aren't making any real progress.
You should definitely play this game as spoiler free as possible, at least until you go a day or two without accomplishing much.
I can't fault the game at all, except for maybe having to use the d-pad controls for the 
flute, since 64 notes without any mistakes was quite unintentionally frustrating.

Holy . Just finished the first ending. I have never played such a great platformer before. I have tried playing hollow knight, and that game didnt hook me as badly as this game did. It was so good.

Each item in the game is so..intrinsically important for the purpose it serves, and yet you can somehow use it for multiple purposes/purposes it was not made for. Im just gonna talk about the disk because (imo) the other items are kinda spoilers. The disc is such a fun tool through which you can both distract the enemies, while also using it to trigger switches, buttons, and also using it to just jump around like a silly ol hobgoblin. Like its so fun to sit on the disc and just straight up hover/ float over some sections of the game entirely.

I love this game. 9/10.

Really awesome game thats a lil bit spooky. Really cool puzzles and the retro style really added. I did a presentation on this game in my graphic design class bc I love this game sm. Pretty awesome and ye

Animal Well came as a surprise and was an absolute pleasure to play from start to end. I loved everything about it - from the beautiful pixel-graphics and the world's atmosphere, to its puzzles and inhabitants, and how everything just effortlessly blended together in a wonderful gaming experience. Animal Well was a beautiful journey, and it felt like much care must have gone into designing the world and its secrets in a way that never felt impossible. 10 / 10 :)

movement/platforming feels great, sound design on point, world is fun to explore. Worth a shot if you like the way it looks. my only personal gripe is the scanlines, I turned them off real quick, but the game feels incredible

One should not be deceived by the game's metroidvania platformer appearance. Even though you at times really have to skillfully jump on platforms and at times really have to "deal" with some enemies in attempts to progress through another door, the overall gameplay is much more about exploring rich and beatiful 2D world filled with ingenious puzzles and peculiar secrets while getting new and new tools to re-examine once found gaps. Very much reminds me the experience of The Witness.

The unique items are fun to discover, interesting to use, and a joy to unlock their secrets.

This game abosluteley blew my mind. Just by trying out things with the items you find the game can constantly surprise the player. It's literally "fuck around and find out".

A unique and brilliant masterpiece. This game surprised me with its cleverness, charm, and beauty. The aesthetic, puzzles, platforming, level design, atmosphere, and sound design are top notch. 

There's always another secret! 10/10

My impressions are mixed on this one...

On one hand each area and tool are pretty well thought out on the whole and the secrets are satisfying to find.

On the other hand, sometimes you have to find a hidden switch to progress, and the map is not easy to use. Also, half the difficulty of some puzzles are in the execution which can be frustrating (some have a timer).

As-is I'd say wait till it has a heavy discount if you really want to play a blob-shaped metroidvania. (for anyone wondering, I reached the main ending, rolling credits & all)
Very eerie & ethereal, lots of fun and i could not put my controller down and stop exploring. kangaroo is nightmare fuel.

I'm generally not sensitive to flashing lights, I very rarely have issues with games. I haven't finished this game yet but there are 2 things that makes my head and eyes hurt. Fireworks and flashing wolf. There is an option for reduced flashing in settings but it only affects fireworks.

Overall I like this game a lot but the flashing makes me not want to play it.

I'm not one to go down the Rabbit Hole (pun intended) on games. For me personally this game was no different. I beat layer 1 of Animal Well and was entirely satisfied. So glad this game has gotten the recognition it deserves. You can just tell every single angle and room of this game was painstakingly crafted with heart and passion and quite simply a love for video games as an art form.

really recommend, this game is levels of depth built on other levels of depth.
big mode as a publisher i really hope starts to move the gaming culture towards unique passion projects like this one.

This is a great puzzle platformer with a lot of mystery and secrets to explore. You'll still have plenty of unanswered questions after reaching the game credits because that is only the first "layer" of the game.

After that, there's quite a bit more to discover. The game has four layers, the first of which is doable on your own and took me about 10 hours. The second is definitely more difficult and I needed a few hints to finish it. The third layer and fourth layers *require* you to look to the community for help. The puzzles in these layers require crowdsourced information, either by design or sheer obscurity. This game is impossible to 100% on your own. I believe there are still outstanding mysteries yet to be solved. I ended up using a guide to finish up the third and fourth layers, putting me at a total play time of around 25 hours.

I very much enjoyed the game throughout and am very impressed that all this was done by a one-man development team. Whether you're a casual puzzle enjoyer or a hardcore code cracker, this game has something for you. Support the dev and have yourself some fun in the beautiful and unsettling world of Animal Well.
cool game that makes you think you are smart sometimes also you'll never believe how much space it requires

It's a great game with great art. I will say if you plan on playing this game to mark things on your map if you find something that might be something as it probably is. The art style can make a lot of things on the floors and walls blend in and can easily miss things. For the most part the main quest and the puzzles/hidden stuff can be found if you keep looking but there is some puzzles that are not required that you will most likely need to look online to solve as these puzzles feel more like they are meant to be figured out by the community to drive engagement with the game.

What a wonderful experience. It deserves all the praise it has been getting.
Incredibly rewarding to finally figure out the solution to that one puzzle you've been sitting on for half an hour.
this game is good, your gonna need a high attention span for the puzzles tho...
The only Halo game I've played where you get eaten by a dog. (Seriously tho, amazing there's never a boring frame in this game even if you get lost there's always somewhere pretty to explore)

$25+ for 1.5 hours of gameplay. Even in the early 90s they made games with more content and replay value than this. If you're interested wait for it to drop to $5 because that's all it's worth (assuming the greedy developers will ever let it drop that low)

~Excellent~ puzzle filled metroid-brania. I know I only scratched the surface of the depth this game has to offer but even so I thouroughly enjoyed my time with it. Once you think you're done with this dense and well-portioned metroidvania it reveals a host of tantalizing secrets if you have the patience or determination (and brain power) to see them through. I was perfectly content with my bite-sized portion of the game that I finished in just a few days, but if you were hoping for somehitng longer it would appear there is an ocean just below the surface in the Animal Well.
Bought this game on the switch as a big fan of dunkey and loved it so much I had to buy it again on PC. Absolutely amazing metroidvania-like.

Pretty good!

I enjoyed this. A mostly chilled out puzzle-platformer where you play a little blob dude who can only jump and collect cool gadgets. These cool gadgets are nicely inventive, often have multiple uses and are satisfying to use. The graphics are what drew me to the game and are a very nice, very consistent mix of deep blues, purples and blacks (and all the other colours too but mostly those) and the levels are nicely animated, from the vines swaying when brushed against to the other inhabitants of The Well. 

I got lost once or twice but the game isn't *too* big so I got back on track eventually. This is a nice time.
Amazing game, great puzzles and very atmospheric. All of the tools are really innovative and fun!

Everything is a puzzle. Whenever I've had a wild idea, thinking there's no way this could possibly be a solution to this random detail that may not even actually be a puzzle, it was. I recommend taking your time and coming back to this game again and again over time, the later puzzles can really take a while to figure out, and I can't imagine getting through them in only a few sittings.

A distillation of all of your favorite metroidvania elements in one extremely small and focused package, enhanced by unique and creative abilities, beautiful low-res pixel art, and its distinct lack of combat. While it doesn't necessarily do anything *ground-shattering,* ANIMAL WELL stands tall among its contemporary metroidvanias because of how much it manages to do (and do ~well~) with such a limited set of resources.

I would absolutely recommend you stop reading reviews and go play this game already. Last I checked, it was sitting at a cool Overwhelmingly Positive, is that not good enough?! Is there NO pleasing you??!

Really interesting and original puzzle Metroidvania, with emphasis on the "Metroid". Continues to surprise throughout, all the way until the credits, more than enough to inspire me to find all the secrets.

This is probably the best money ever spent. This is now my second favorite game ever. I loved trying to figure everything out. I got to the credits before I realized there is a map. I hope they make more of these, I really look forward to it.
Play this game as blind as possible. The puzzles are really rewarding to figure out.
Really good game. Had lots of fun. Can tell a lot of love went into this Animal Well

They were not fucking kidding there are so many Animals in this well!!

I cannot think of a game that has a world that feels more vibrant and realised than Animal Wells. Despite having a tiny game file as well the world of Animal Well ends up feeling way bigger than like all other games.

Cannot recommend enough honestly

This has to be one of the most mind-blowing games I've ever picked up. I can't fathom, how simple, yet complex each challenge awaits you. Matched with beautiful visuals that pairs each little hurdle the game throws at you. Not only is it required, but there is a a constant urge to explore every nook and cranny in hopes of discovering something completely new and rewarding. The physics in this game are hands down incredible that work seamlessly without flaw. I'll probably come back and write my progress and or completion for the game.. ahh who, am I kidding. Probably not. But I guarantee you this game will have me hooked for months to come.
Unbelievable game. Got me through some of the hardest parts of my life. Inspired me to go back to college and persue game development. Truly a staggering work of art.

game is good. this was one of my first metroidvania titles that i actually played and got into on steam. I highly recommend this to anyone who likes platformers and puzzles. go in knowing nothing and enjoy as the world unfolds. the game is very satisfying and if i could wipe my memory and play this game again for the first time i would.
A little short but very good. Art style is so cool. Gameplay is very fun. I would only recommend this game if you are a fan of puzzle/collectable style games.

The only Metroidvania I've ever enjoyed. Every achievement can be won without outside help, but the deeper secrets require community effort. The map is large enough to explore for hours and hours, yet its not annoying to get around. Beautiful graphics, love this game.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (95%): players mostly praise the graphics, the gameplay and the music.
Complaints are few and spread across different topics, with no single problem standing out.

details.text: Recent reviews are about as positive as the all-time score, so the game's reception has held steady.
Newer players are less positive than veterans: 84% against 99% for players with over 50 hours.
